dialogue.find_me.legacy_combat_rescue.1: The pact answers. Drive it back.
dialogue.find_me.legacy_combat_rescue.3: By the pact, strike it down.
dialogue.find_me.mount_summon.4.reply: I heard you, {player}. Stop rushing me.
dialogue.find_me.companion_summon.4.repl: Do not rush, {player}. I am here.
dialogue.find_me.storage.1.reply: Call me when you need me, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.home_storage.2.reply: Do not make me wait too long, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.home_set.1.reply: Then I will wait here for your voice, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.registered.1.reply: As long as you call, I will find you, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.sleep_revive.1.call: I waited so long for you, {name}.
dialogue.find_me.no_registered.1.reply: There is no such name on the paper, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.pvp_disabled.0.reply: I cannot interfere in a knight's battle, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.already_riding.0.reply: You are already riding me, silly master.
dialogue.find_me.already_riding.1.reply: Look down, {player}. I am right here.
dialogue.find_me.already_riding.2.reply: I would, but you are already on my back.
dialogue.find_me.already_riding.4.reply: Realized the problem yet, foolish master?
dialogue.find_me.already_riding.7.reply: Stop looking, {player}. I am carrying you right now.
dialogue.find_me.already_riding.8.reply: I'll take that as praise for being too fast to see.
dialogue.find_me.occupied.0.reply: I cannot get away right now, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.too_high.1.reply: Find somewhere I can stand first, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.no_water.0.reply: Are you trying to dry me out, {player}?
dialogue.find_me.void_mount_unsafe.0.rep: There is nowhere to stand, {player}. I am sorry.
dialogue.find_me.void_mount_unsafe.1.rep: I would only fall with you, {player}.
dialogue.find_me.void_companion_unsafe.0: I cannot reach that place, {player}. I am sorry.
dialogue.find_me.void_flying_mount.0.rep: Leap on, {player}. There is nothing below us.
dialogue.find_me.void_flying_mount.1.rep: I have you, {player}. Do not look down.
dialogue.find_me.void_flying_mount.2.rep: Hold on, {player}. I can fly through this.
config.find_me.mountCooldownTicks.toolti: Normal mount summon cooldown in ticks.
Mount summon cooldown in ticks while the player is in combat.
config.find_me.returnCooldownTicks.toolt: Short cooldown after returning a pet to its saved origin.
config.find_me.rescueMinFallDistance.too: If the player is falling at least this many blocks, rescue summon can trigger.
config.find_me.safeSearchRadius.tooltip: Radius used to look for a safe teleport or revive landing spot.
config.find_me.enableCreatureArrivalVoic: Play the summoned creature's own voice when summon or rescue is accepted.
config.find_me.creatureArrivalVoiceVolum: Volume for summoned creature voice. 1.0 is full volume; default is 0.4.
config.find_me.magicEffectVolume.tooltip: Volume for FindMe magic effects such as circles, storage, summon, rescue, and contract ceremony sounds. 1.0 is full volume; default is 0.65.
config.find_me.postTeleportInvulnerabili: Invulnerability seconds given to players and pets after forced teleport or rescue.
config.find_me.enablePvpSummon.tooltip: Allows summon while the player has recently hurt or been hurt by another player.
config.find_me.enableCombatSpeedBoost.to: Gives a short movement speed boost after mounting during combat.
config.find_me.combatSpeedBoostPercent.t: Movement speed boost strength after mounting during combat.
config.find_me.combatSpeedBoostTicks.too: Movement speed boost duration in ticks.
config.find_me.dialogue.tooltip: Editable subtitle text for summon, rescue, storage, and reminder dialogue.
config.find_me.enableDialogue.tooltip: Show FindMe's flavor subtitle dialogue. Off by default; when disabled, FindMe uses practical action-bar messages.
Dialogue after a mount appears. Format: first line|second line. Supports {player} and {name}.
config.find_me.companionSummonDialogueLi: Dialogue after a companion appears. Format: first line|second line. Supports {player} and {name}.
Dialogue after a mount rescue appears. Format: first line|second line. Supports {player} and {name}.
config.find_me.companionCombatRescueDial: Dialogue when a companion answers a nearby threat. Format: first line|second line. Supports {player} and {name}.
config.find_me.storageDialogueLines.tool: Dialogue when storing a creature. Format: first line|second line. Supports {player} and {name}.
config.find_me.homeSummonDialogueLines.t: Dialogue when a creature with a home is summoned. Format: first line|second line.
Dialogue when storing a creature that has a home. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.homeSetDialogueLines.tool: Dialogue when setting a creature's home. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.homeClearDialogueLines.to: Dialogue when clearing a creature's home. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.registeredDialogueLines.t: Dialogue when a creature is registered into FindMe. Format: first line|second line.
Dialogue when sleep revives and places a creature nearby. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.sleepReviveStoredDialogue: Dialogue when sleep revives a creature but stores it because nearby space is unsafe. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.blockedDialogueLines.tool: Dialogue when summon or rescue was answered but the space is blocked. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.busyDialogueLines.tooltip: Dialogue when the previous summon or storage animation is still closing. Format: first line|second line.
config.find_me.cooldownDialogueLines.too: Dialogue when summon is still on cooldown. Format: first line|second line. Supports {player}, {name}, and {seconds}.
config.find_me.noRegisteredDialogueLines: Dialogue when no creature is registered for this key. Format: first line|second line.
Dialogue when the selected creature cannot be found or restored.
Dialogue when PvP summon is disabled.
config.find_me.alreadyRidingDialogueLine: Dialogue when the player is already riding the selected mount.
config.find_me.occupiedDialogueLines.too: Dialogue when the selected creature is occupied by another passenger.
config.find_me.tooHighDialogueLines.tool: Dialogue when a companion cannot appear safely at the player's height.
config.find_me.noWaterDialogueLines.tool: Dialogue when a swimming creature has no nearby water.
config.find_me.voidMountUnsafeDialogueLi: Dialogue when a non-flying mount cannot be summoned over the void.
config.find_me.voidCompanionUnsafeDialog: Dialogue when a companion cannot be summoned over the void.
config.find_me.voidFlyingMountDialogueLi: Dialogue when a flying mount answers directly over the void.
config.find_me.summonLines.tooltip: Legacy action-bar lines shown after a normal summon. Use {name} for the creature name.
config.find_me.rescueLines.tooltip: Legacy action-bar lines shown after a rescue summon. Use {name} for the creature name.
config.find_me.combatRescueLines.tooltip: Legacy action-bar lines shown when a companion is called against a nearby threat. Use {name} for the creature name.
config.find_me.customMounts.tooltip: Entity ids that should always be considered rideable mounts.
config.find_me.customCompanions.tooltip: Entity ids that should always be considered non-rideable companions.
config.find_me.customFlying.tooltip: Legacy movement override. Prefer customMoveTypes for new configs.
config.find_me.customSwimming.tooltip: Legacy movement override. Prefer customMoveTypes for new configs.
config.find_me.customWalking.tooltip: Legacy movement override. Prefer customMoveTypes for new configs.
config.find_me.customMoveTypes.tooltip: Preferred movement override format: entity_id=walk, entity_id=fly, or entity_id=swim.
config.find_me.previewScaleOverrides.too: Advanced GUI preview scale overrides, formatted as entity_id=scale. Example: dragonmounts:dragon=0.75
config.find_me.guiOpacity.tooltip: Opacity for wheel GUI 2D elements. Does not affect 3D entity previews.
config.find_me.enableVault.tooltip: Keep emergency creature snapshots before risky removal or death operations. Recommended: true.
config.find_me.vaultCapacity.tooltip: Maximum emergency creature snapshots kept per player.
config.find_me.enableAutoBackups.tooltip: Periodically back up each player's Find me lists. Recommended: true.
config.find_me.preventBoundCreatureDeath: Bound mounts and companions do not drop equipment or inventory items when they die. FindMe still keeps its death snapshot for revival. Enabled by default.
config.find_me.enableAutoBinding.tooltip: Automatically recognize owned creatures and add them to Find me lists. Disabled by default; use Name Paper for manual contracts.
config.find_me.enableContractAnimation.t: Plays the manual binding ceremony before the creature is stored. Disable to bind immediately.
config.find_me.enableContractCinematicCa: Uses a temporary side-view camera during the Name Paper ceremony. Disable to keep the player's normal view while effects play.
config.find_me.backupCapacity.tooltip: Maximum full-list backups kept per player.
config.find_me.enableSleepRevive.tooltip: Allows dead companions to return when a player wakes up.
config.find_me.sleepReviveCooldownMinute: Minutes between sleep revive attempts per player.
config.find_me.sleepReviveChance.tooltip: Chance that sleeping revives one dead companion.
config.find_me.sleepReviveSpawnEntity.to: If enabled, revived creatures try to appear nearby when there is safe space. Disable for packs with destructive large mobs.
